name: York County, PA
findings: York County has 1,399 nonprofit organizations. 667 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 533 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, York County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few community organizations list public events
observations.text: 6 community organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through community groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 76 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 76 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
